extraction_notes: Scanned PDF with no text layer; every value was transcribed from the page images (pypdf-extracted JPEGs). The title and all sample dates are 2025 (06-26-25, 12-08-25) but the 'About This Report' boilerplate still says the monitoring period is January 1 to December 31, 2024; data_year recorded as 2025 from the title and sample dates. Tables 3-5 give one row per well (Old Well, Well #4, Well #5) rather than per column; source_group names the well. In most rows the 'Range of Detections' column holds the unit (ppm/ppb) instead of a range. Several results are printed as '0' rather than 'ND' and are recorded as value 0 with detected false. Well #4 iron (350 ppb) and turbidity (7) exceed the printed SMCL/MCL yet Table 7 (violations) and Table 9 (groundwater TT) say 'None'. Fluoride PHG printed '.1'. Table 6 (unregulated contaminants) is empty; Table 8 counts are blank; Tables 10-11 and the RTCR section on pages 7-10 are unfilled template text.
